- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: line 5878 (`security_pass_mark_followup_merge_checked "${SECURITY_PASS_ADVISORY_ISSUE_NUMBER}"`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The caller appends to `security_pass_followups_merge_checked` even when the state write that should create the corresponding follow-up row failed.
  WHY: The merge-checked entry becomes the only remaining state footprint and makes the orphan invisible to future recovery.

- Requirement: "Rebind only when the last audited SHA is a non-empty ancestor of the new head, the relevant rev-list is non-empty, and every new commit is a merge commit with empty combined-diff output" (verbatim from the linked-issue scope)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `security_pass_rebind_if_no_new_project_lines`, the parent-count guard at line 4745
  Evidence of absence: The implementation hard-codes `awk '{print NF}' -ne 3`, rejecting any commit that is not an ordinary two-parent merge. Octopus sync merges that produce an empty combined diff are therefore excluded from rebinding and trigger a full LLM audit even though the spec only requires "every new commit is a merge commit with empty combined-diff output". The new `test_security_pass_evil_merge_and_non_merge_commit_fall_through_to_audit` test actively encodes the octopus-fall-through behavior with `__octopus_sync_merge__`.
  Severity: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, lines 5874-5885, the `if [[ "${SECURITY_PASS_ADVISORY_ISSUE_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]` block
  Evidence of absence: The implementation removes the backlog entry whenever `SECURITY_PASS_ADVISORY_ISSUE_NUMBER` is set, but the upstream `create_security_pass_advisory_followup` sets that variable at line 5841 even when its own state write at lines 5830-5836 fails (warning at line 5838). The partial-failure case is not covered by the only existing failure test (`MOCK_SECURITY_PASS_ADVISORY_CREATE_FAIL`, line 4391), which forces a full create-exit-1, not a state-write failure after a successful API call.
  Severity: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
